verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication device. It has no automation or workflow layer that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. The scriptable ykman CLI and the SDKs are building blocks a user could script around, not a product-native automation versioning capability, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
